cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You choose whose oven we borrow. I'll do the mixing; winning with borrowed equipment will be better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for tonight. I'll bake; you make sure they hear we did it overnight.

reason: Final dialogue edit replaces detached imagining of a prize with B concrete role securing tonight access and making the overnight comeback effort known.
